ILLUSTRATIVE APP PREVIEW

A LITTLE CLOSER LOOK

A little nudge to get together.

The best stories usually start with a plan that actually happened. SideQuest brings the ideas, the planning and the memories into one home for your group.

01

Find your next thing

Browse a shared activity catalogue. Narrow things down by category, cost, duration and group size, or save a good idea for another day.

02

Get everyone on the same page

Create a quest or trip, find a date with a poll, collect RSVPs and keep the schedule, bring list and conversation together.

03

Keep the good bits

After the plan, keep photos, video, audio, quotes and favourite moments in your private group. Switch between groups without mixing their plans or memories.

EARLY ACCESS / ANDROID

Try SideQuest.
See what clicks.

Bring your people.

Sign in with Google or email, then create a private group or join one with an invite. Head to Discover for activity ideas and turn one into a plan.

SideQuest uses hosted services for accounts, group data and media. It needs an internet connection. Current notifications are inside the app; these test builds are still being refined.
